description: Work Assignment Notifications and My Pending Works - When work is assigned to a user, auto-generate a notification. Add a 'My Pending Works' tab in the notifications page showing all open/assigned work records for the current user. Supervisors/admins can assign work to specific users. Deadline reminders appear as notifications.
steps: 1. Add an 'assignWork' endpoint to src/server/routers/work.ts that accepts (workRecordId, assignToUserId, assignToUserName, assignedByUserId, assignedByUserName, deadline, remarks). It updates the work record's userId/userName and adds 'assignedAt', 'assignedBy', 'assignedByName' fields to the record. Uses supervisorProcedure.
2. Extend MockWorkRecord interface in src/lib/mock-data/work-records.ts with optional fields: assignedAt (string|null), assignedBy (string|null), assignedByName (string|null).

3. Update the notification store (src/stores/notification-store.ts) to add a new notification type 'work_assignment' to the group options and add work-related notifications in the mock data: work assigned notifications (linking to /ledger), deadline reminders for items due within 2 days, overdue work alerts.

4. Add a 'getMyPendingWorks' endpoint in src/server/routers/work.ts (protectedProcedure) that returns all work records with status OPEN or SUBMITTED for the current user (from ctx.session.user.id), sorted by priority then deadline proximity.

5. Update src/app/(protected)/notifications/page.tsx to add a tabbed interface at the top with two tabs: 'Notifications' (existing content) and 'My Pending Works' (new content). The My Pending Works tab shows a compact table/list of assigned work records with columns: date, category badge, description (truncated), priority badge, days remaining vs target, status, and a link to /ledger. Include a count badge on the tab showing number of pending items.

6. Add work assignment mock notifications to the notification store's initial data: 3-4 notifications like 'Work Assigned: Drawing Review CLW-TM-GA-001-R3' with actionHref pointing to /ledger, and 2 deadline reminders like 'Deadline approaching: Spec review due in 2 days'.
7. Update the sidebar (src/components/layout/sidebar.tsx) to show a badge count on 'Notifications' nav item showing pending works count (use a static number like 4 for mock).
8. Update graphify.json to add FEAT-018 entry for this feature.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build passes without TypeScript errors
Notifications page has two tabs: Notifications and My Pending Works
My Pending Works tab shows a list/table of assigned work records
Work assignment notifications appear in the notifications list
Deadline reminder notifications appear for items approaching due date
assignWork endpoint exists in work router with supervisorProcedure
Sidebar notifications nav item shows a badge count
